dataset: Validation gates — every strategy must pass all applicable gates
note: Gates are fixed in advance and applied before a strategy may be scored, promoted, or earn leaderboard rewards. A strategy that fails any applicable gate is not deployed. Threshold values are proposals pending the owner's decision (see Questions Q03 and Suggestions S03).

rows.rule: Composite model edge must meet or exceed the minimum edge threshold (proposal: NFL minimum edge per established edge-qualification practice).
rows.pass_criteria: edge >= configured minimum (default proposal: per-sport NFL threshold used by edge models)
rows.rationale: No strategy is deployed without a minimum price advantage; prevents noise-level bets from qualifying.

rows.rule: Expected value per $1 must meet or exceed the minimum EV (proposal: positive and above a small floor).
rows.rationale: Edge in probability must translate to positive expected profit per dollar.

rows.rule: Strategy must demonstrate results over the minimum sample with a significance test (CLV-based, which reaches significance in ~50-100 bets versus ~2,000+ for raw profit).
rows.pass_criteria: minimum sample met AND CLV significance criterion passed
rows.rationale: Separates skill from luck at the earliest defensible sample size.

rows.rule: Strategy must pass a walk-forward validation on data not used for tuning; no look-ahead or in-sample-only results are accepted.
rows.pass_criteria: walk-forward period passes the same edge and significance thresholds
rows.rationale: Out-of-sample performance is the only honest test; prevents overfitting.

rows.rule: Multi-leg strategies must price legs jointly using the stored correlation matrix; strategies with legs above the correlation threshold must use joint distributions.
rows.pass_criteria: joint pricing implemented and correlation values recorded for all leg pairs
rows.rationale: Correlated legs invalidate naive probability multiplication and overstate edge.

rows.rule: Strategies involving teams with confirmed starter absences must apply the injury-adjusted signal; unadjusted signals are not eligible for those games.
rows.pass_criteria: injury adjustment applied and recorded for every game in the strategy's sample
rows.rationale: Backups replacing starters materially change expected performance; ignoring it is a known source of false edges.

rows.rule: Leaderboard scoring must be computed on luck-adjusted metrics (CLV and luck-adjusted efficiency), not raw win/loss.
rows.pass_criteria: CLV and luck-adjusted metrics computed for every scored bet
rows.rationale: Directly implements the requirement to remove luck from the equation.
